paper_style.palette_strategy: 方法图复用黄色 trained、蓝色 frozen、橙色 memory、绿色 answer 的语义色；统计图按任务/工具使用蓝、红、绿、紫、橙等 categorical palette；主表和消融表复用彩色 domain header、绿色 Δ/gain cell、bold/underline best-second-best。颜色承担主要类别键，只有少数 marker/文字提供冗余。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF p.3/4/5/7/9/10/22/23 的图表主体主要是矢量对象；p.1 Figure 1 含多个嵌入栅格图，p.8 Figure 5 含大量工具/图标栅格对象并与矢量排版混合。表格与 caption 为 PDF vector；公开仓库提供的是 partial rendered PNG assets，不是完整 PDF source。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文、caption、公式和表格稳定使用 CMR/Nimbus-like roman 与 Computer Modern math；Figure 2–4 的 schematic serif/数学标签和 Figure 6–9/12 的 DejaVu Sans chart 字体形成局部一致性，Appendix Figures 10–11 使用 Aptos-like chart text。黄/蓝方法语义在 Figure 2/4 一致，绿 Δ 表规则在 Table 1–3 一致，但跨图表没有统一的色盲冗余。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Left: Performance of AGENTFLOW with a 7B-scale backbone before and after Flow-GRPO tuning across ten diverse reasoning benchmarks. Flow-GRPO substantially improves performance by enhancing planning quality and tool-calling reliability. Right: AGENTFLOW achieves consistent gains over top baselines, including base LLMs, tool-integrated RL models, and training-free agentic systems. All 7B results use Qwen2.5-7B-Base/Instruct as the backbone and tools.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: (a) Overview of AGENTFLOW, a trainable agentic system for in-the-flow planning and tool use. Four modules (planner, executor, verifier, generator) coordinate via a shared evolving memory M and toolset K, given a query q. The planner policy is optimized on-policy inside the system’s multi-turn loop to enable adaptive, long-horizon reasoning. (b) A single state transition, showing the action a^t, execution result e^t, and verifier signal v^t that update the memory from M^t to M^{t+1}.

color.semantic_mapping: 黄色表示 trained planner，蓝色表示 frozen executor/verifier/reference，橙色表示 evolving memory，绿色表示 answer，浅色框表示 token/输入输出，红色图标强化 trainable 状态。

encodings.facet: panel (a) workflow versus panel (b) single transition
encodings.text: module names, q/K/M^t, a^t/e^t/v^t/M^{t+1}, input/output schemas

figures.data_and_statistics: 机制图，无样本、均值或不确定性。左图表示 multi-turn loop，右图把 §3.1 与 Eq. (2) 的单轮状态接口具体化；Algorithm 1 p.16 复现相同 planner→executor→verifier→memory 顺序。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.1 四模块和 MDP 定义 → Figure 2 → Eq. (2)/Algorithm 1 → Figure 4 的 Flow-GRPO rollout。
design_strengths: 全局 loop 与局部 state transition 并排，能从系统边界下钻到 action/event/memory。
trained/frozen legend 和 input/output 框减少箭头歧义。
面板间的语义层级与正文模块命名一致。
design_weaknesses: Memory 回流方向需要追踪长箭头。

未画 termination、reward 或 variable horizon。

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3: Comparison of two paradigms of LLMs with tool use. (a) Monolithic tool-integrated reasoning models train a single policy to interleave reasoning (e.g., <think>) and tool calls (e.g., <tool_call>) within a single, full-context trajectory. (b) Agentic systems decompose tasks across multiple specialized modules (e.g., planner, coder) that collaborate. These systems are typically training-free, orchestrated by handcrafted logic or prompting.

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Optimization for our proposed agentic system AGENTFLOW. Given a query q, an evolving memory M, and a toolset K, the policy model generates actions that target sub-goals and select tools. It is trained via Flow-based Group Refined Policy Optimization (Flow-GRPO), which enables multi-turn reinforcement learning and stable optimization under collaborative dynamics.

color.semantic_mapping: 黄色为 policy/trained，蓝色为 reference/reward/frozen，橙色为 rollout container，浅灰为 group/token cards，淡紫为 intermediate outputs，绿色为 result/return。

encodings.line: solid arrows plus large Flow-GRPO feedback arc
encodings.facet: single optimization pipeline with rollout and reward subpanels

figures.data_and_statistics: 算法接口图，无样本、均值或不确定性。中部 group rollouts 和 reward rows 是 trajectory-level construction；§3.2 Eq. (3)–(7) 定义 objective、broadcast reward、group advantage 和 KL。
figures.evidence_relation: §3.2 in-the-flow learning → Figure 4 → Eq. (3)–(7)/Algorithm 1 → Appendix B Theorem B.1/B.3。
design_strengths: 把 rollout→reward→group computation→policy update 串成闭环。
trained/frozen 色彩与 Figure 2 复用，强化系统边界。
group/turn 重复框表达多轮轨迹而无需额外文字。
design_weaknesses: 弧形反馈箭头和 token rows 在窄屏上难追踪。
clipping、KL、zero-variance convention 和 theorem assumptions 未在图中出现。
binary final-outcome reward 的语义不由图本身可读。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用“输入/可训练模块—真实 rollout—reward transformation—update”四段式图连接系统和目标函数，保留回流箭头表示 on-policy。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 2 先固定四模块、memory 和单轮 state；Figure 3 给出 monolithic/training-free prior contrast；Figure 4 把 rollout、reward、group computation、update 连成闭环；Figure 1 与 Tables 1–2 给 cross-domain outcome；Table 3、Figure 5、Figure 8/11 做 planner strategy、失败恢复和 tool preference 诊断；Figure 6–7、Table 4、Figure 9 处理 backbone、horizon、resource 和 training dynamics；Appendix Figures 10–12 补 tool scaling、Musique transition 与 Figure 6 的复现。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure 1–5 的长 caption 解释设置/编码并多处写主发现；Figure 6、10–12 直接写方向性 headline；Figure 7–9 与 Table 2–4 过短，需正文补任务、分母、颜色、平均单位和 uncertainty。标签格式统一为 Figure n:/Table n:，但 Figure 12 未标明它重复 Figure 6。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1–2 复用 domain group → task/Avg./Δ 两级表头；Table 3/4 用单级窄表。Model/Size、task metrics、Avg.、Δ 或 T_max 的顺序稳定，green Δ cell、bold、underline 规则跨主表一致。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 2 的 system/state interface 与 Figure 4 的 Flow-GRPO optimization 落到 Tables 1–2 主结果；Table 3 是唯一直接的 training-strategy ablation；Figures 5/8/9 提供 qualitative/mechanism/efficiency diagnostics。没有 executor/verifier/generator deletion 或 reward broadcast/KL/group-normalization 独立图表，component causality 未完全闭合。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文通过 Figures 6–9、Tables 1–4 建立 scaling、budget、tool 和 efficiency 证据，Appendix D 的 Figures 10–12 追加工具升级、Musique transition 和 scaling 重复图；Appendix B/C/E/F 虽无额外 Figure/Table，但 theorem assumptions、sampling/tool metadata、prompts 和 case trajectories 决定主对象的复现边界。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: CMR/Nimbus-like roman 与数学体在正文、caption、表格稳定；schematic 图和 statistical plots 的内部字体分别呈现 serif/DejaVu/Aptos 局部系统。图内小字号普遍约 5.5–9 pt，表体约 6.5–7 pt，caption 保持正文罗马体。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 方法图的 yellow-trained/blue-frozen/orange-memory 语义在 Figures 2/4/3 中稳定；Table 1–3 的 green gain 与浅色 domain header 稳定；统计图按 chart 局部重设 blue/red 或 tool green/blue/purple，跨对象能凭 legend 对齐但缺少全局色盲冗余。

most_reusable_patterns: Figure 2 的“全局 multi-turn loop + 单轮 state transition”接口图。
Figure 4 的“policy/reference → live rollouts → reward/group computation → update”闭环图。
Table 3 的固定系统边界 matched training-strategy 对照，以及 Figure 7 + Table 4 的 budget/performance 与 consumed-resource 配对。
failure_patterns: 短 caption 缺少 ratio/Δ 分母、任务定义、平均单位、样本量和 uncertainty。
主图表提到三次 trial 但不展示 spread/error；颜色承担主要类别键且缺少形状/线型冗余。
Figure 12 重复 Figure 6 却未交叉标注；Figure 5 单 case、Figure 8/11 行为共现、Figure 9 非同构 ToRL 对照均不足以单独证明 component causality。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文用“系统状态接口图 → Flow-GRPO 闭环图 → 跨域主表/overview → planner、tool、budget 诊断 → 附录复现切片”的层级，把 in-the-flow planner 优化连接到结果和轨迹，但把不确定性与严格因果边界留给正文/附录文字。
